notes: Sourced from Biamp's official data sheet (rev.1025, Nov 2025) and the official TesiraFORTÉ X 400/800/1600 Installation & Operation Guide (Feb 2023), both from downloads.biamp.com. Ethernet port 1 is a plain RJ-45 (no PoE); ports 2-5 are RJ-45 with PoE+ (IEEE 802.3at Class 4, 30W) and also carry AVB/Dante/AES67/VoIP traffic. USB port is USB Type-B, used for USB Class 1 Audio (up to 2x2 channels, 16/24-bit, 48kHz) plus HID - no USB data-transfer speed (e.g. 2.0) is stated in the spec, so grade is omitted per instructions. The 2 mic/line inputs and 2 mic/line outputs, and the 4-channel GPIO (Logic I/O), are all on pluggable 3-pole/6-pole screw-terminal (euroblock) connectors per the Architects & Engineers spec and back-panel legend. Power input is an external locking 2.5mm DC barrel jack (back panel item 7); the external power brick itself runs on 100-240VAC 50/60Hz and the whole system (unit + PoE+ loads) draws <150W, but the unit's own rear-panel receptacle is the 2.5mm DC barrel, not a mains inlet - modeled here as dc-barrel accordingly. Desktop/surface-mount unit (comes with wall-mount bracket); no rack ears, so rackUnits omitted (optional RMX 100 rack shelf accessory exists but is not native rack-mounting).

ports.note: Locking 2.5mm DC barrel jack fed by external inline power supply; threaded lock prevents accidental disconnection and prevents mismatched lower-voltage 2.5mm supplies from being used. Overall system power consumption <150W at 100-240VAC 50/60Hz (measured at the external supply's mains input).
